title: robbietilton/Compositor
why_read: An open-source Photoshop alternative for Mac written in Swift, of general interest to Mac developers and designers but not deeply novel technically.
analysis: Compositor appears to be a native macOS image editing application positioned as an alternative to Photoshop, built in Swift. Without more architectural detail in the description, it's hard to judge what's technically novel versus a straightforward reimplementation of familiar editing tools. It could be interesting to Mac developers curious about building complex creative tools natively, but the description alone doesn't convey unique technical contributions.
